pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal patches with sharp pixel gradients at the edges; spatial area is maximal on the mid-flank, while neck patches exhibit more complex, slightly crenulated margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Highly continuous network of light cream pathways; junction nodes are well-defined with consistent pixel thickness across the lateral torso, narrowing toward the ventral and posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the dorsal neck, appearing as a dark brown fringe against the background.
